item.title: Missouri prisoners report being forced to shovel snow in subzero temperatures
item.description: Advocates and incarcerated people say prisoners were ordered outside during the recent winter storm, and punished with segregation or discipline if they refused.

item.title: Waiting for a decision in Missouri's abortion rules trial
item.description: A trial that could determine the future of abortion access in Missouri has wrapped up, and the decision is now in the hands of a judge. Planned Parenthood is suing to get several laws targeting abortion providers off the books, but the state got its chance this past week to defend the regulations.

item.title: Missouri 'Chimp Crazy' star Tonia Haddix appeals 4-year sentence in secret chimpanzee case
item.description: Haddix pleaded guilty in March 2025 for crimes related to lying about having a chimp named Tonka. But her attorneys say the 46-month sentence is higher than federal sentencing guidelines.

item.title: Friends and family of Missouri man detained by ICE await word of deportation: 'It's un-American'
item.description: Green card holder Owen Ramsingh has spent months in a U.S. detention center in El Paso, Texas, where at least three people have died in recent weeks. Columbia community groups have raised funds to support the family's move to The Netherlands.

item.title: NTSB blames 'deep' systemic failures for Kansas flight's deadly midair collision near D.C.
item.description: After a yearlong investigation, the National Transportation Safety Board did not find a single cause for the deadly collision, but blamed the crash on multiple systemic failures. 67 people died when an Army helicopter collided with an American Airlines flight from Wichita.

item.title: Kansas City families struggle to find child care
item.description: Finding affordable, quality childcare that fits their schedule feels like an impossible task for many parents. Kansas City parents navigating the workforce while raising young children say the region needs more options.

item.title: Adiós, La Fonda
item.description: A beloved Mexican restaurant in Kansas City is closing for good. We'll hear from the sisters who run the eatery and are taking stock of their decades of work at La Fonda El Taquito.

item.title: Kehoe wants former Kansas City council member for police board. A key vote worries about bias
item.description: Missouri Sen. Maggie Nurrenbern says former Kansas City Councilwoman Heather Hall, who is married to a retired KCPD officer, cannot be impartial. Nurrenbern needs to sign-off in order to send Hall’s nomination to the full Senate by a Feb. 6 deadline.

item.title: How one KCPD officer with a violent history is being handled
item.description: In 2023, a Kansas City police officer shot and killed two people and injured a third, but he won’t face criminal charges. And that’s not the only legal settlement involving Blayne Newton. Hear about Newton’s conduct and how it has fanned the flames of tension in the community.

item.title: Jackson County sheriff opposes proposed local mask ban for law and immigration enforcement
item.description: Sheriff Darryl Forte said lawmakers have a duty to prioritize community concerns over politics. Jackson County Legislative Chair Manny Abarca, who introduced the measure to ban masks, countered that accountability “shouldn’t be a problem for good cops.”
